seo__search_description: Oakdene Ladies Boutique offers clothing, salon services and a private, supportive space for women doing it tough. By appointment only.
hero__intro: A warm, private and supportive space for women who are doing it tough.
intro_details__text: The Oakdene Ladies Boutique is a warm, private and supportive space designed for women who are doing it tough. We offer more than just clothing — we offer an experience that treats women with dignity and care.
boutique_images__image_alt_2: Salon area at the Oakdene Ladies Boutique
eligibility__text: You are automatically eligible if you meet any of these:
eligibility__list: Receiving Centrelink under $1,200/fortnight **and** hold a concession card
You have been referred by a service or professional
eligibility__text_2: We will chat with you if 2 or more of these apply:
eligibility__text_3: Maximum **2 visits per 12 months per household**. Emergency override possible with staff approval.
eligibility__text_4: You can be referred from services, health professionals, schools, or DV services. Referral only.
access_promise__text_2: We believe in access. If cost is a barrier, please speak with us. **No woman will be turned away due to financial difficulty.**
cta__heading: Ready to visit or make a referral?
